From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 readout: runbook + dependency clearance

Team —

I want to get alignment on the QBR readout and make sure the runbook + dependency list is cleared before we finalize slides. Attached are the current QBR deck (v3) and the first-draft runbook (QBR-Redwood-Runbook-v1.pdf). High-level status for the initiatives we will call out: 

- OKR 4.1 (latency tail reduction): 65% done. Experiments showing 12% P95 reduction but still seeing regressions on long-seq traffic. Blocker: infra capacity to run extended perf harnesses.
- OKR 5.2 (Dedicated rollout): staging infra set; blue/green has worked in canary. Blocker: final procurement approval for the extra reserved capacity in us-west2.
- OKR 6.3 (observability retention): small gap on trace retention export; engineering has mitigation plan but needs SRE help on DB TTL tuning.

Asks (please action / reply inline):
1) Markus & Sean — can infra commit the additional 8-GPU pool for perf harness runs between 10/19–10/23? If yes, what approvals are required?
2) Laura — can you confirm exec three-slide narrative we want for the QBR (I marked two candidates in the deck)?
3) Vanessa — can you incorporate runbook steps for the on-call fallback (see section 3) and attach updated runbook?
4) Everyone — please flag any downstream customer risks (Acme Analytics is a candidate callout) by EOD Thursday 10/15.

I will pull together a consolidated slide Friday afternoon. If we can clear the infra + procurement asks this week, the dry run will be on Wed 10/21.

Thanks —
Elliot
Elliot Price
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Attachments: QBR-Redwood-Runbook-v1.pdf, QBR-deck-slide-deck-v3.pptx

Elliot —

Thanks for the clear ask. Quick notes: 
- I prefer the candidate "Consolidated economics + reliability" narrative (slide 4 in your deck). I can tighten bullets and hand it back by Thursday morning.
- Downstream risk: Acme Analytics has two PoCs running; if we throttle their ingest during perf tests we should notify their engineering lead (Emma Chen). I've pinged Emma to hold a 15-min heads up next Tue.
- On the procurement piece: I can start the purchase request but will need the exact sku and term you want reserved (monthly commit vs burst).

Short update from infra side: we can provision the 8-GPU pool requested for 10/19–10/23, but it requires a signed commitment for the temporary reserved nodes (vendor needs a PO or self-service commit). I have a contact at the cloud vendor who can do a 2-week hold (cloud-sales@globocloud.com).

Approvals needed: 
- Finance/Procurement PO (Laura can start)
- Legal sign-off for short-term addendum (I can get the Ops legal contact to fast-track)

- If perf runs cause regressions, the rollback plan will trigger an automatic switch to the previous kernel version and enable the KV-cache bypass. Steps and owner assignments are in section 2.
- I added a short communications plan for customers (one-line template to notify Emma at Acme and general status to broader customers).

Questions / requests: 
- Who will own the communication to Acme? Laura, can you handle the customer heads-up?
- Markus, please confirm whether the vendor hold requires an internal PO number so procurement can process it this afternoon.

Vanessa
